text: I can compare HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 on multiplexing, HOL blocking and transport protocol.
I can classify HTTP methods as safe, idempotent, or neither, and explain why idempotency matters for retries.
I can explain the status code ranges and name the key codes for system design (200, 304, 401, 429, 502, 503).
I can design a caching strategy using Cache-Control, ETag and content-hashed filenames.
I can explain the difference between no-cache and no-store and when to use each.
